deferral_rationale: Severity downgrade Major->CONCERN: committed evidence independently verified (8/8 consumption float-identical, 10/10 cells flat, replay 5/6 stale); failure direction on a degraded rerun is conservative (still AFFECTED = over-warns the #504 promotion gate, never a false SAFE); checks are printed + persisted in the JSON so degradation is inspectable, not swallowed. One-shot audit whose committed evidence ships. Fix opportunistically: assert traj_val is not None, n_match == len(consumption), and a per-cell flatness bound before writing the verdict.
